The '''General Ministry Agencies''' were various task-oriented organizations that oversaw and operated the machinery of aspects of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Agencies included [[Navigation (agency)|Navigation]], [[Communications (agency)|Communications]], [[Port Operations]], [[Records/Legends|Records]], [[Facilities]], and [[Transportation (agency)|Transportation]].<ref name="CTD" />
